$$
\begin{aligned}
  \operatorname{Organic seed proportion of acreage}_{i}  &\sim N \left(\mu, \sigma^2 \right) \\
    \mu &=\alpha_{j[i],k[i],l[i]} + \beta_{1}(\operatorname{Value organic seed}) +  \\
                                  &\ \beta_{2}(\operatorname{Distrust quality}) + \\
                                  &\ \beta_{3}(\operatorname{Buyer requirements}) + \\
                                  &\ \beta_{4}(\operatorname{Certifier request}) + \\
                                  &\ \beta_{5}(\operatorname{Lacks desirable traits}) + \\
                                  &\ \beta_{6}(\operatorname{Availability}) + \\
                                  &\ \beta_{7}(\operatorname{Non-commercial seed sourcing}) + \\
                                  &\ \beta_{8}(\operatorname{Farm size}) + \\
                                  &\ \beta_{9}(\operatorname{Crop diversity}) \\
    \alpha_{j}  &\sim N (\gamma_{0}^{\alpha} + \gamma_{1}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{Research funding}) + \\
                                             &\ \gamma_{2}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{Organic IP}) + \\
                                             &\ \gamma_{3}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{Grower to supplier ratio}) + \\
                                             &\ \gamma_{4}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{Sales}), \\
                                             &\ \sigma^2_{\alpha_{j}})
    \text{, for Region j = 1,} \dots \text{,J} \\
    \alpha_{k}  &\sim N \left(\mu_{\alpha_{k}}, \sigma^2_{\alpha_{k}} \right)
    \text{, for survey\_year k = 1,} \dots \text{,K} \\
    \alpha_{l}  &\sim N \left(\mu_{\alpha_{l}}, \sigma^2_{\alpha_{l}} \right)
    \text{, for maincrop l = 1,} \dots \text{,L}
\end{aligned}
$$
